CustomField.description: File-type questions only. When set, an uploaded answer is attached to the Application Form's Document Checklist Item matching this Document Type instead of being stored directly on the Application Form's Files. Holds a DocumentType record Id — not a Lookup because DocumentType cannot be the target of a custom relationship field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Only used when Data Type is File. Leave blank to attach the uploaded file directly to the Application Form instead of a Document Checklist Item.
CustomField.label: Document Type Id
